verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents AI summaries with automatic labels and categorization, a first-party mechanism that could surface important mail. Nothing shows it identifies government or legal senders, or that it prioritizes or alerts on deadline-bearing items. The MCP "find the letter from the IRS" line is only a hypothetical usage example. Missing for 10: documented detection of IRS, state and service-of-process mail, priority flagging or urgent notifications, deadline extraction, and independent or hands-on corroboration that such mail is categorized correctly.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail
AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized
